a13.rewritten_query: Self-RAG critique scores rank generated segments CRAG confidence thresholds classify retrieval
a13.hypothetical_document: In Self-RAG, critique scores assigned to generated segments are used to rank those segments, with higher-scoring candidates preferred during selection. In CRAG, confidence thresholds classify retrieval outcomes, determining whether retrieved information is judged reliable or requires correction based on threshold comparison.
